_comment: Cached fallback snapshot for lib/substack.ts. The live RSS feed at https://citizenofnowhere.substack.com/feed is the source of truth at runtime; this file is used when fetch fails (e.g., sandbox egress blocked, Substack 5xx) so the home page can always render. Refresh by running scripts/refresh-substack-feed.ts or by editing manually after publishing a new post.
